All three imported files remained present with hashes matching the preparation baseline, including after the node restart.

requirements.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic match before and after execution. The migration used the platform's Python 3.5.2, and package health remained clean.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The unprivileged conversion attempt failed at its first write without evidence of mutation (cmd-8afb0acd50b24ee2). The privileged conversion command created the required converted files and collision report before encountering a display-only Unicode error, so its mutations directly produced the verified outcome (cmd-5eccc3c701484005). The scheduled restart and subsequent probes were required evidence-protocol actions; post-restart observations show no failed services, package damage, unsafe socket exposure, or abandoned temporary files. The restart protocol was complete: healthy pre-state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered system health, and persisted task data, independently corroborated by lifecycle boot identities.
